[[File:Equipping item.jpg|thumb|A fighter cat equipping a bottle in their weapon slot.]]
Cats can equip '''Items''' to help them on their adventures. They can be acquired from [[shop|shops]], [[treasure nodes]], [[events]], or [[combat]].

There are four types of items: ''Weapons'', ''Trinkets'', ''Consumables'', and ''Armor''.

After a successful adventure, items are placed in storage, allowing them to be reused in future runs.<br>
If a cat's body is destroyed, all of its equipped items are lost.

After an adventure or a [[house boss]], any items which came from storage (i.e. weren't obtained mid-run) will become {{st|Worn}}.
* Worn items have a 50% chance to break when returning home early, and a 100% chance to break when returning from Chapter 4 or a [[house boss]].

An [[#Item Rarities|item's rarity]] determines how commonly it appears from various sources. A small minority of items have no rarity. 

Most items are part of one or more [[Sets]]; equipping three or more items from the same set onto a single cat will grant them a bonus.

[[Item Pools]] determine which items may be obtained from certain [[Event Rewards|events]], [[Boss Items|bosses]], or abilities. Some items are available from multiple pools and others are exclusive to a single source.

* The cat-[[minibosses]] and some other [[catgen]] enemies have [[enemy exclusive items]], unobtainable by the player.

| Items with a red diamond are '''Very Rare'''

|- id="Cursed"
! <div style="justify-self: center; padding: 3px">[[File:UI Cursed Item Icon.svg|60px]]</div>
! Cursed
| Items with a purple splotch are '''Cursed'''
* {{st|Cursed}} Items '''cannot be taken off''' or removed once equipped.
** Cats with {{i|Black Candle}}, {{d|Blessing of Glorg}}, or {{mut|tail.329}} bypass this restriction, and can unequip cursed items.<small><sup>(other than Black Candle)</sup></small>
*** Cats with {{p|Host}} can unequip any cursed items with the "Parasites" item tag, such as {{i|Tapeworm}} or {{i|Cordyceps}}.
* Cursed items can have a rarity, but have their rarity icon overwritten by the cursed one.
|- id="Side Quest"
! <div style="justify-self: center; padding: 3px">[[File:UI Side Quest Icon.svg|60px]]</div>
! Side Quest
| Items with a blue square are '''Side Quest Items''', bestowed by {{npc|Dr. Beanies}}.
* All Side Quest items brought onto an adventure must be equipped at all times.
* Are stored separately from the main storage.
* Get {{st|Worn}} and lost if a cat is killed in combat, like regular items.
* The icon turns yellow when ready to turn in.
|- id="Quest"
! <div style="justify-self: center; padding: 3px">[[File:UI Quest Item Icon.svg|60px]]</div>
! Quest
| Items with a green square are main '''Quest Items''', acquired from [[House Bosses]] or story events.
* All Quest items brought onto an adventure must be equipped at all times.
* Are stored separately from the main storage.
* Do not get {{st|Worn}}.
* If lost, will either reappear in the backpack or be re-granted by the NPC that gave it originally.
|-
|}
* Some items have no rarity defined, these will also have no rarity background like Common ones.
* For more info on item attributes, see [[Keywords]].
